name: Session History
description: Contributes the SessionHistory tool: paginated, filterable read access to any saved session's transcript (this one or a past one) from the append-only JSONL store. Window records, list/search sessions, filter tool calls by name, read spilled tool-output blobs, or produce the full markdown/XML dump. Reads only through the ctx.host capability surface (sessions:read, blobs:read). Distinct from SessionInfo, which reports the current run's live state.

tool.name: SessionHistory
tool.description: Read the conversation history of a saved session from the on-disk transcript store (~/.minimal-agent/sessions/<sid>.jsonl). It reads this session, its earlier turns, or any past session. It is the archival counterpart to SessionInfo, which reports the live runtime state: context %, quota and cost. Actions: 'window' (default) pages the records with stable indexes, newest 10 by default (anchor 'end'), and anchor 'start' with offset/limit walks forward. 'meta' gives a summary of a session (model, cwd, created, record counts, first prompt, liveness). 'list' enumerates the saved sessions, newest first (filter by query/cwd). 'search' finds text in one session (sid set) or in the recent sessions (sid omitted). 'tool_calls' filters the invocations by tool name. 'blob' reads the full pre-truncation output of one tool call by tool_use_id. 'dump' gives the whole session as markdown or XML (large, prefer 'window'). The sid defaults to 'last' and accepts any unique id prefix (e.g. 'bc567526'). The tool limits each result: it clips the previews for each record, and each response gives the totals and the next-page offsets.

sid.description: Target session id, a full id, or any unique prefix (e.g. 'bc567526'), or 'last' (default) for the most recent session in this cwd. If there is no session in this cwd, the tool uses the globally most recent session. An ambiguous prefix gives an error with the matching candidates. Not needed for 'list', optional for 'search'.

anchor.description: window: page from the oldest record ('start') or the newest ('end', default).

offset.description: window/list/search/tool_calls: records to skip from the anchor. Default 0.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults: window 10 (max 500), list 25, search 20, tool_calls 20.

previewChars.description: window/search: per-record body clip in characters. Default 600 (window) / 160 (search).

query.description: search: case-insensitive substring to find. list: filter sessions by sid/cwd substring.

cwd.description: list: only sessions whose recorded cwd equals this path.

tool.description: tool_calls: only invocations of this tool name (e.g. 'Bash'). Omit for all tools.

toolUseId.description: blob: the tool_use id whose raw spilled output to read.

maxBytes.description: blob: clamp the returned blob text to this many bytes. Default 65536.

tool.reason: perfect collision: plugin IS the tool name
